description: EvenBetter skills for iOS: feature and epic planning, SwiftUI build guides, an analyze, validate and repair audit against Apple's HIG and WCAG 2.2, runtime accessibility tests, Accessibility Nutrition Labels and App Store launch.

interface.longDescription: Curated EvenBetter skills for iOS. Plan a screen or a whole app with closed questions, build with SwiftUI guides, and audit the project against Apple's HIG and WCAG 2.2: analyze writes an HTML report, validate checks it, repair applies the fixes, and runtime XCUITest audits confirm findings. Release skills cover Accessibility Nutrition Labels and App Store submission.
defaultPrompt: Use EvenBetter iOS to plan an iOS feature.
Use EvenBetter iOS to analyze this SwiftUI app.
Use EvenBetter iOS to repair the validated findings in my audit report.
